card.name: Space before a duration number
card.fires_on: The space right after phrases like "at least", "minimum of" or "for" when a number of days, weeks or months comes next. It appears in label text on treatment length or timing before or after a dose.

modes.label: Minimum treatment length
modes.description: The space after "continued for a minimum of" or "at least" before a count of hours or days.
